request.description:
Generates a complete full-stack project with backend (Node.js + Express + Prisma) and frontend (Next.js + TypeScript + Redux) in a single ZIP file.

**Project Structure:**
```
project-{timestamp}/
├── backend/          # Complete Node.js backend
├── frontend/         # Complete Next.js frontend
├── docker-compose.yml
└── README.md
```

**Configuration Options:**

**Project Info:**
- `projectName`: Project name (used for package.json)
- `projectDescription`: Project description
- `author`: Author name and email
- `port`: Backend server port (default: 5000)
- `frontendUrl`: Frontend URL for CORS (default: http://localhost:3000)
- `frontendApiUrl`: Backend API URL for frontend (default: http://localhost:5000)

**Database:**
- `dbProvider`: Database provider - "mysql", "postgresql", or "mongodb"

**Authentication:**
- `primaryIdentifier`: Login identifier - "email", "username", or "both"
- `enable2FA`: Enable two-factor authentication
- `enablePasswordRecovery`: Enable password recovery flow

**Features:**
- `enableAdminPanel`: Include admin routes and controllers
- `enableRBAC`: Enable role-based access control
- `enableGroups`: Enable user groups feature
- `enableNavigation`: Enable dynamic navigation system

**Admin User:**
- `adminEmail`: Default admin email
- `adminPassword`: Default admin password
- `adminFirstName`: Admin first name
- `adminLastName`: Admin last name

**Frontend Configuration:**
- `defaultTheme`: Default theme - "light" or "dark"
- `defaultRole`: Default public role for registration
- `primaryColor`: Primary brand color (hex)
- `secondaryColor`: Secondary brand color (hex)
- `logoPath`: Logo path relative to public folder
- `selfRegisterRoles`: Comma-separated list of roles for self-registration

**Roles:**
Array of role objects with:
- `name`: Role name
- `description`: Role description
- `registrationType`: "admin" or "public"
- `isSystemRole`: Boolean
- `permissions`: Array of permission strings
- `default`: Set one role as default (for public roles)

**Navigation Tree:**
Array of navigation nodes with:
- `id`: Unique identifier
- `name`: Display name
- `type`: "page" or "section"
- `path`: Route path (for pages)
- `icon`: Icon name (lucide-react icons)
- `isPublic`: Boolean
- `order`: Display order
- `accessRoles`: Array of role names
- `children`: Array of child nodes (for sections)

**Response:**
Downloads a ZIP file containing the complete project structure.

response.name: Success - Download ZIP
response.body:
Binary ZIP file containing:
- backend/ folder with complete Node.js backend
- frontend/ folder with complete Next.js frontend
- docker-compose.yml for easy deployment
- README.md with setup instructions

request.description: Generates backend only (Node.js + Express + Prisma). Downloads a ZIP file with the complete backend project.

Generates frontend only (Next.js + TypeScript + Redux). Downloads a ZIP file with the complete frontend project.

**Configuration:**
- `projectName`: Package name (kebab-case)
- `appName`: Application display name
- `apiUrl`: Backend API URL
- `author`: Author info
- `defaultTheme`: "light" or "dark"
- `defaultRole`: Default role for registration
- `primaryColor`: Primary brand color (hex)
- `secondaryColor`: Secondary brand color (hex)
- `logoPath`: Logo file path
- `primaryIdentifier`: "email", "username", or "both"
- `selfRegisterRoles`: Comma-separated role list
